_meta.thesis: Denoising steps rent depth, not width: per-metric (width, depth, steps) scaling for masked-diffusion TTS.
_meta.target_venue: DiffuLM @ NeurIPS 2026 (extended abstract, 4 pages main text, non-archival, double-blind, OpenReview)
_meta.note: This file and protocol.html are the single source of truth for all numeric values. index.html is theory/motivation only and contains illustrative placeholder values by design. Precedence on conflict: grid.json (architecture, recipe, sampler, calendar) -> protocol.html (thresholds, procedures, statistics) -> task.md (operations) -> index.html (never a source of numbers).
_meta.relationship_to_aspect: Independent sibling of Project ASPECT (autoregressive). Shares the iso-N shape grid dimensions because they were validated for the same parameter formula; shares nothing else. The AR anisotropy headline is reserved for the later full-length paper; ASPECT-D's primary claims are the diffusion-native step hypotheses H-D2/H-D3.

backbone.type: bidirectional (non-causal) transformer, masked discrete diffusion over audio codec tokens
backbone.param_formula: N_nonembed = 12 * depth * width^2 (pre-LN, RMSNorm, RoPE, GELU MLP ratio 4, head_dim 64; attention 4w^2 + MLP 8w^2 per block; embeddings and heads excluded)

codec.name: mimi
extra_tokens: MASK (absorbing state, one per codebook table)

conditioning.text: espeak-ng phonemes (phonemizer package, en-us, stress marks), always visible, prepended
conditioning.speaker: 3-second prompt audio tokens, all 8 levels, always visible; NO speaker encoder — prompt continuation is the only identity pathway
conditioning.length: target frame count fixed before generation: chars(target_text) * sec_per_char * 12.5, sec_per_char = median over 10k training clips computed once in Phase 0 (fallback 0.075 s/char). Precedent: MaskGCT shows total-length-only conditioning suffices for masked-generative TTS.
conditioning.cfg: OFF. No condition dropout at training, no guidance at inference. Guidance is a confound axis; it is deliberately excluded from v1.

backbone.training_objective: SoundStorm-style coarse-to-fine masking. Per example: sample level l ~ Uniform{1..8}, mask ratio t ~ Uniform(0,1]; levels < l fully visible, level l cells masked i.i.d. with prob t, levels > l fully replaced by MASK; phonemes and prompt always visible. Cross-entropy on masked cells of level l only. One embedding table per codebook (summed at input), one output head per codebook.

sampler_frozen.scheme: MaskGIT confidence decoding, level-by-level 1..8; within each level exactly T refinement steps with cosine unmasking schedule
sampler_frozen.T_definition: T = refinement steps PER LEVEL, uniform across the 8 levels; total network forward passes (NFE) = 8*T
sampler_frozen.confidence_noise: Gumbel noise on log-probs, scale annealed linearly 1.0 -> 0.0 across the T steps within a level
sampler_frozen.token_sampling: categorical at temperature 1.0 for newly committed tokens
sampler_frozen.note: Frozen for every config, seed, and T. Never tuned per shape or per T (see task.md directive 4).

D.note: Ladder-shift pivot P2 only; P2 additionally requires calendar headroom per protocol.html gate G6.

seeds.note: Seed 2 trains only if gate G6 milestone M3 is met early AND gate G5 projects <= 70% of the compute cap. Stretch runs are the first calendar cut.

tolerance.note: Width must be a multiple of head_dim. Fits regress on actual (width, depth, T), never nominal budget; record actual N per run.

training.grad_accum: as needed; effective batch_sequences fixed at 256 for ALL runs

mup.note: mu-Transfer for width; depth transfer verified at gate G1b (protocol section 5).

training.val_loss_definition: masked CE at fixed t grid {0.25, 0.5, 0.75} averaged over levels, fixed val masking RNG, so val loss is comparable across runs

fallback_order: MLS English 2000h subset (same held-out speaker rule)
LibriTTS-R full 585h (activates row G2-alt in protocol section 8)

eval_zs.purpose: all metrics, at every T in T_eval_grid

eval_sets.note: No long-form set: masked diffusion has no autoregressive stopping, hence no runaway metric. Reliability appears instead as degenerate-output rate, defined in protocol section 6.

asr.primary: openai/whisper-large-v3, greedy decoding, Whisper English text normalizer

speaker_sim.primary: WavLM-large SV checkpoint from microsoft/UniSpeech (seed-tts-eval protocol), cosine vs ORIGINAL prompt waveform (SIM-o)
speaker_sim.fallback: microsoft/wavlm-base-plus-sv; log the switch, apply uniformly

mos_proxy.policy: tertiary; if not installable after 2 distinct attempts, drop and log — never substitute an unvalidated proxy

latency_model: serial_latency_per_utterance = 8 * T * depth * c_layer(width), tokens fully parallel within a step. c_layer measured once per width in Phase 4 on the eval GPU and logged; the design-rule table in results.html uses measured c_layer, never an assumed constant.

compute.gpu_class_reference: B200; other GPUs convert by measured tokens/sec ratio vs the Phase-2 pilot, factor logged
priority_cut_list_if_projected_overrun: 1. cancel stretch seed 2 runs (if any scheduled)

calendar.slippage_rule: At each milestone check (gate G6): if projected completion of the NEXT milestone exceeds its date, apply the calendar cut list below, one cut at a time, until the projection fits. Log every cut.
calendar_cut_list: 3. drop budget A (grid becomes B, C: 10 configs)
6. freeze training wherever it is; fit and write with completed runs, stating coverage honestly in the paper's limitations
calendar.writing_floor: Regardless of experiment state, Phase 7 (paper) begins no later than M6 minus 1 day. A submitted 4-page abstract with partial results and honest limitations beats an unsubmitted complete grid.
